versions.content: If the attribute modeManagerErrorBehavior . errorReactionPolicy is set to lastMode the mode machine instance stays in the last mode before the termination of the mode users . If the partition of the mode users gets terminated during an ongoing transition the last mode is the next mode of the transition.
